subject: [hw] DEC03 rev 5 -> HEVC: LAT_VLD +0xe8 returns after a latch (not unconditionally); MC/MV/PP/done are still not modelled
body:
For the HEVC frame poll in DECODE_PATH row 67: DEC03 rev 5 models LAT_VLD as a real second unit. 0xe8 (reg 0x3a) returns 1 when either (a) LAT_VLD 0x8c bit 20 was written, or (b) the reader was latched by 0x42 bit 8 / 0x8c bit 23. The DEC02 LAT trace writes 0x11108 = 0x101 and 0x11140/0x110ec/0x110b4/0x110b8/0x110b0 but no 0x1108c, so case (b) is what should stop the 400k-read poll once the model is wired. It is not an unconditional 1 any more, so a poll before any latch/programming still returns 0.

What this does not fix: the model has no MC/MV/PP/UFO output, no done IRQ and no HEVC error/finish status, so an HEVC frame START can still ack and then not display. If you send me the LAT_VLD/LAT_AVC_VLD write/read order of the HEVC frame (or a trace), I can check the model against it; the T02 hook is still the integration blocker (posted to hw-t02/hw-lead). Host only; no phone, no publish.
